## Cardiff social caption — blocked, valid for morning 19 September only

A quiz to crack. A giant frog to climb. A little trip back in time. 🧡

Four Cardiff plans for Saturday 19 and Sunday 20 September:

🔎 LITTLE DETECTIVES — St Margaret's in Roath has a free children's quiz. Saturday 12.30–5.30pm; Sunday 2–5.30pm. No booking. Our pick for 5–12s with a grown-up; the tower is adults-only. Church entry via the porch is accessible.

🌳 FIND THE WOODEN CREATURES — Bute Park's sculptures include a climbable frog and beetle. Free outdoor exploring at your own pace; supervise little climbers.

🏛️ KEEP AN INDOOR PLAN — National Museum Cardiff is free to enter,10am–5pm; galleries close 4.45pm. Under 16s need an adult. Some exhibitions cost extra; advance free tickets are available.

🕰️ STEP INTO OLD WALES — St Fagans,10am–5pm, free entry and£7parking. Historic buildings and room for a picnic. Under 16s with an adult; uneven paths and limited pushchair access inside buildings.

Pick one that fits your family: https://donext.co.uk/

## Birmingham social caption — blocked, valid for morning 19 September only

Big wheels today. Little discoveries all weekend. 🧡

Birmingham family plans for 19–20 September:

🚍 SATURDAY 19 — Brum Transport Festival,11am–5pm. Cars, buses and transport displays across Victoria, Centenary and Hippodrome squares. Free, no booking, all ages. Outdoors; dress for the weather.

☀️ SATURDAY 19 — Look up at the glowing Sun inside The Exchange. Helios is free, no booking,8am–5pm. Closed Sunday.

🎺 SUNDAY 20 — Moor Pool Heritage Festival,11am–3pm. Crafts, trails, LEGO and sports tasters around the hall and estate. Free, no booking. Some uneven paths/steps; hall wheelchair entry at the side. Parking limited.

🦖 EITHER DAY — Lapworth Museum,noon–5pm. Fossils, crystals and a dinosaur to discover indoors. Free, no booking; pram/wheelchair access and babychange. Campus parking£3.

Bring your grown-up and pick your adventure:

## Bristol weekday email —21–25 September, unsent; recheck before use

Subject: A singalong or a tiny treasure hunt?

Hi there,

For little ones, Central Library's regular timetable has rhyme sessions Monday 21 and Wednesday 23 at 10.45am for 0–3s, plus Friday 25 storytime at 10.45am for 1–4s. Free, no booking; siblings welcome. Check for changes to these recurring sessions.

For a family detective mission, collect a free map for the Aardman mini-museum hunt at Bristol Museum & Art Gallery. Tuesday–Friday 10am–5pm; the British and World Wildlife Galleries are closed.

[Library timetable](https://www.bristol.gov.uk/residents/libraries-and-archives/services-for-children-and-young-people/baby-bounce-and-rhyme-and-storytime-sessions) · [Museum hunt](https://www.bristolmuseums.org.uk/whats-on/bristol-museum-and-art-gallery/mini-museum-hunt-aardman/)
